name: Bakumatsu Ishin: Amakakeru Koi
original_name: 幕末維新 天翔ける恋
source:
The story is set in the late Edo period. After the Black Ships arrived, the crackdown for anything foreign-related by the extremists have gotten worse, even within the Capital. One day, the protagonist gets in trouble when she drops a photo related to foreign culture.

After a drifter accuses her of being a traitor to the country, she nearly gets struck down until “he” appears and saves her.

[from [url=https://news.qoo-app.com/en/post/64028]QooApp[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在江户时代末期。黑船到来后，极端分子对涉外事物的打击更加严厉，甚至在京城内部也是如此。有一天，主角因丢下一张与外国文化有关的照片而陷入麻烦。

在一名漂流者指控她叛国后，她差点被击倒，直到​​“他”出现并拯救了她。
